instruction: Candid sports photograph, full shot. Inside a covered outdoor pavilion, the boxer in the beige t-shirt (R1) on the left leans forward to throw a punch at the boxer in the blue tank top (R2) on the right, who blocks with both gloves up. In the background, a bystander in a blue shirt and cap stands watching. Bright natural daylight illuminates the scene.
elements: R1 leans forward to throw a punch at R2
R2 blocks R1's punch with both gloves raised
R3 is a background bystander watching R1 and R2
R1 and R2 are engaged as boxers in a combat exchange
boxing gloves are used in the interaction
the scene is inside a covered outdoor pavilion

questions.q: Is R1 the boxer leaning forward to throw a punch at R2, rather than R2 throwing a punch at R1?
questions.element: R1 is the puncher and R2 is the target/defender

questions.q: Is R2 the boxer blocking R1's incoming punch with both gloves up, rather than R1 blocking a punch from R2?
questions.element: R2 has the defensive blocking role against R1's punch

questions.q: Is R3 watching from the background as a bystander while R1 and R2 are the two active boxers, rather than R3 being one of the fighters?
questions.element: R3 is the onlooker and R1/R2 are the combat pair

questions.q: Does R1 lean forward toward R2 in an attacking boxing posture?
questions.element: R1's attacking body configuration toward R2

questions.q: Does R2 hold both gloves up in a defensive blocking posture while facing R1?
questions.element: R2's defensive blocking body configuration toward R1
